arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Stris argued clients have equitable interests in trust assets.
Mr. Palmore stated no ERISA exception exists to Article III.
Mr. Joshi cited centuries of trust law supporting beneficiary suits.
Chief Justice Roberts questioned whether abstract losses constitute injury.
